name: Selfie videos making funny faces at camera
what_it_is: A collection of close-up selfie-style clips where young people, mostly women, cycle through exaggerated comedic facial expressions — pouts, winks, squints, tongue-out and face-squishing — often lip-syncing or reacting to an audio clip. A few add a punchline cutaway (cartoon clips, football celebration footage), but the shared activity is performing playful faces directly to the camera.
